fees.notes: Monash Malaysia official 2026 fee schedule (international, per year); Malaysian RM48,480. 6% service tax applies to international students from 1 Jul 2025. Source: https://www.monash.edu.my/study/postgraduate-and-research/fees

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 6.5 (no band less than 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 79 or PTE 58
requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor's degree requiring at least four years of full-time study in a relevant field including a research component in the fourth year (honours), or a master's degree with a significant research component; qualifications deemed equivalent by the Graduate Research Committee
